tasks.label: FITTRACK Web - Chrome chính
args: $url = 'http://localhost:8080/#/login'; $job = Start-Job -ArgumentList $url -ScriptBlock { param($u); for ($i = 0; $i -lt 180; $i++) { try { $response = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:8080/' -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 2; if ($response.StatusCode -eq 200) { Start-Process $u; break } } catch { Start-Sleep -Seconds 1 } } }; flutter run -d web-server --web-port 8080 --dart-define-from-file=config/dev.json
